problem: The 100 m marked recipe contains 145 paint polygons, while RuntimeMaterial rejected the 128th polygon before the scene could start.
root_cause: A defensive global polygon limit from the short-road implementation was left in the CUDA recipe loader. The generator had no equivalent end-to-end runtime check.

fix.device_upload_scope: Only paint polygons intersecting the current tile including its gutter

tests.new_regression: A 145-polygon recipe must initialize and bake a tile with only its intersecting paint applied.

scope: This proves the complete marked asset initializes and produces a full OptiX image. It is not the 100 x 10 m mission or sustained-RFT acceptance run.
